notes: Sabotrack test play: alone in the Great Hall? Open Sabotrack and play against 4 bots as Crew or Saboteur. Bots walk around doing tasks, report bodies, vote, and (one of them, when you're crew) hunt you down. Nothing is saved. Also: the host sets how far the crew can see, with a live preview, and saboteurs can hide in lockers, coffins and crates.
